description: Semantic hard-negative regression cases. Each case is checked by backend/tests/test_semantic_sense.py through the GENERIC mechanism named in 'mechanism' -- no case is special-cased in code. status HANDLED = the system gives the right outcome; HANDLED_CONSERVATIVELY = it avoids the wrong claim but does not reach the best answer; KNOWN_FAILURE = the current output is wrong and is pinned here so a future backend can be measured against it; KNOWN_LIMITATION = the right thing is avoided at a recall cost.
labelled_by: assistant (expected outcomes describe correct behaviour, not a benchmark metric)

cases.mechanism: label evidence rule: a single ordinary word does not establish a sense
alias-sense validation: altLabel with a different prefLabel needs another label of the concept in the same text

cases.left: monitor trials per GCP principles and ICH guidelines
cases.mechanism: acronym-sense validation: short upper-case curated token needs other technical terms in the same text

cases.left: deploy on AWS, GCP and Docker

cases.mechanism: none -- exact label matching sees the head noun only
token containment: the more specific phrase is the CHILD; never SAME_CONCEPT
no stemming identity: morphological variants are not auto-SAME_CONCEPT

cases.expected: not mapped; best out-of-scope candidate reported
